title: Majority mean after bribing the first coordinates
statement: For natural numbers $k,m$ and a sign $b$, consider majority on $k+m$ coordinates, with the first $k$ coordinates replaced by $b$. Its mean equals the mean of the function on the remaining $m$ coordinates that takes the threshold sign of $k b$ plus the sum of those coordinates.
